dataset: Census of India 2011, Table C-01: Population by religious community (district level, Total/Rural/Urban, persons/males/females)
producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
fetched: 2026-09-29, plain public HTTPS GETs (curl), no login, no API key, no custom headers

files.raw_nada/: 38 files downloaded unmodified from the ORGI Census Digital Library (NADA). DDW00 = India + state rows only; DDW01..DDW35 = one per state/UT with state, district, sub-district and town rows; plus the India-level C-01 Annexure and Appendix (sect/religion detail). Exact URL, NADA catalog page, idno, bytes and sha256 per file: sources_manifest.csv
files.raw_datagov/: 36 files downloaded unmodified from the file URLs that data.gov.in's 'Population by Religious Community, 2011 - <STATE>' resources point to (https://censusindia.gov.in/datagov/C-01_Religion_Released_Religion_tables/DDW{SS}C_01_MDDS-2011.xls). Different re-save of the same table (flattened one-row header, saved by NIC Dec 2015); every number and every row key is identical to raw_nada (checked by the build script). Kept because data.gov.in publishes this table under GODL-India.
files.religion_district_2011.csv: Tidy output as specified: 640 districts x {Total, Rural, Urban} = 1,920 rows; persons only.
files.religion_district_2011_full.csv: Same 1,920 rows with persons/males/females (_p/_m/_f) for all 9 categories, plus source_file.
files.religion_state_2011.csv: India (00) + 35 states/UTs x TRU = 108 rows, from DDW00C-01 (persons/males/females).
files.validation_report.json: Every check run by build_religion_district_2011.py (all pass).
files.build_religion_district_2011.py: Rebuilds all outputs from raw_nada + raw_datagov, offline.

code_scheme.state_code: 2-digit Census 2011 (MDDS) state code, '01' J&K ... '35' A&N Islands, kept zero-padded as text. 35 states/UTs as of 2011.
code_scheme.district_code: 3-digit Census 2011 (MDDS) district code, '001'..'640', nationally unique and contiguous, kept zero-padded as text. District code alone is a unique key; state_code is redundant but consistent.
code_scheme.tru: 'Total' | 'Rural' | 'Urban' (title case; the raw files use Total/Rural/Urban too).
code_scheme.join_to_pca: Join on district_code (and tru). The official PCA file DDW_PCA0000_2011_Indiastatedist.xlsx uses the same codes: columns State (2-digit), District (3-digit), TRU. Verified: all 1,920 district x TRU rows match 1:1, total population equal in every row, state codes equal, district names equal after normalising case/punctuation.
code_scheme.join_to_boundaries: datameet 2011_Dist shapefile (already in ../boundaries/datameet_2011_dist): join int(district_code) = censuscode. Verified 640/640 match; ST_CEN_CD equals int(state_code) for all 640. Do NOT use DT_CEN_CD (a within-state serial, e.g. Adilabad = 1). The shapefile has one extra polygon, censuscode 0 'Data Not Available' (J&K, ST_CEN_CD 99), with no census data. 20 names are spelt differently (e.g. 'Khargone (West Nimar)' vs 'West Nimar', 'North Twenty Four Parganas' vs 'North 24 Parganas'), so never join on name.

quirks: District rows are identified as district_code != '000' AND subdistrict_code == '00000' AND town_code == '000000'. The state files also contain state-level town rows (district '000', town code set: e.g. Srinagar, Anantnag in J&K; DMC(U), NDMC, Delhi Cantt in Delhi; Devaprayag in Uttarakhand; 4 towns in Manipur; Siliguri in WB; GHMC in AP) for towns that span districts. These are NOT districts and are excluded.

Tripura's four district names have no 'District - ' prefix in the raw file (West Tripura, South Tripura, Dhalai, North Tripura); every other name is 'District - <name>'. The prefix is stripped in the outputs.
DDW13 (Nagaland) labels one header 'Other religions and persuasions (incl.Unclassified Sect.) - 2011'; the column order is the same as every other file.
Nine fully urban districts have Rural rows of all zeros: 094 New Delhi, 095 Central (Delhi), 342 Kolkata, 518 Mumbai Suburban, 519 Mumbai, 536 Hyderabad, 603 Chennai, 634 Yanam, 636 Mahe.

Geography is as of Census 2011 (640 districts). For present-day seats: state 28 ANDHRA PRADESH includes today's Telangana (districts 532 Adilabad to 541 Khammam); state 01 JAMMU & KASHMIR includes today's Ladakh UT (003 Leh(Ladakh), 004 Kargil); 25 DAMAN & DIU and 26 DADRA & NAGAR HAVELI are separate (merged into one UT in 2020); many districts have since been split. The seat -> 2011-district crosswalk has to handle this.
State names are the 2011 Census spellings in upper case (e.g. 'JAMMU & KASHMIR', 'NCT OF DELHI', 'ANDAMAN & NICOBAR ISLANDS', 'ODISHA'). Map them to app state names by state_code, not by name.

'other_religions' = 'Other religions and persuasions (incl. Unclassified Sect.)'; what it contains is listed in raw_nada/DDW00C-01 Appendix MDDS.xlsx, and the sects folded into the six major religions are in the Annexure.
